name: Pico de Gallo
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup chopped white or yellow onion
1 ½ tbsp stemmed, seeded, and minced jalapeño or other chiles

steps: Add salt, pepper, chiles, lime juice, and garlic.
Let stand 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

culture.text: Pico de gallo, also called salsa fresca, and salsa cruda, is a type of salsa commonly used in Mexican cuisine. It is traditionally made from chopped tomato, onion, and serrano peppers, with salt, lime juice, and cilantro.
